name: Bounding Box Culling
definition: A view-dependent culling step in the Pre-processing Stage that drops Gaussians whose projected bounding box does not intersect the camera viewport.
summary: Bounding Box Culling is a view-dependent pre-processing step that filters 3D Gaussians by testing their projected 2D ellipse against the camera viewport, differing from general AABB culling by using screen-space rejection.
